android.desc:
Do you like cool live wallpapers? Do you like different apps? You will love this app 😁
As long as you can find it on the Internet, you can set it as your home screen live wallpaper, yes, it's so incredible 😎
This is a powerful live wallpaper app, using an advanced wallpaper engine,  It looks a bit like the wallpaper engine on steam, or the lively wallpaper on windows, but more concise, built for Android, and set any website as your live wallpaper with one click.
the main features include:
- Set any internet webpage as live wallpaper, be it video, game or picture 📱
- Powerful rendering engine that lets you enjoy your favorite websites on your home screen 📲
- You can even choose to interact with the web wallpaper you set on the home screen, such as watching news, playing games 🎮
- No extra operations, one-click settings, and make your home screen unique from now on🙈
- Infinite possibilities, only your imagination can limit you 🕶
Come and try it!

quotes.text:
I just did some googling and found at least one app to do exactly this on Android. This is now my phone background!!

(I used this, but it does leave a small "please purchase" banner at the top, until you pay: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nuko.livewebwallpaper)
